name: TianJin JinRong TianYu Precision Machinery Inc.
summary: TianJin JinRong TianYu Precision Machinery Inc. specializes in the research, development, production, and distribution of high-precision metal molds and their derivative products. The company's extensive offerings include critical components for the electrical sector, such as precision parts for low-voltage and medium-voltage power distribution, industrial automation systems, and energy equipment. Additionally, it supplies a wide array of automotive components, encompassing shock absorption, safety, air conditioning, seating, and lightweight structural elements. The company also manufactures products tailored for the growing energy storage market, catering to residential, industrial, and commercial applications. Established in 2004, the firm operates from its headquarters in Tianjin, China.
